---@id e59fb775-946f-4711-be95-857448a20f46
---@referenceName tripo_sheep_motion.lua
-- Physical sheep: preserve impulses instead of snapping to pasture coordinates.
---@displayName 可推动绵羊
local U=CS.UnityEngine
local rb,home,target,anim,last=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
local nextChoice,pushedUntil=0,0
local previousActor=nil
local nextPush=0
local function play(name)
 if name~=last and anim and anim.enabled and anim.Controller and anim:Play(name) then last=name end
end
function Start()
 rb=self.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(U.Rigidbody));home=self.transform.position
 anim=self.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.ModularAnim.Runtime.UGCAnimator))
 if not rb then U.Debug.LogError('Sheep physics body is missing');return end
 -- Existing generated colliders must be convex when attached to a dynamic body.
 local ms=self.gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(U.MeshCollider),true)
 for i=0,ms.Length-1 do if not ms[i].isTrigger then ms[i].convex=true;ms[i].enabled=true;ms[i].material.dynamicFriction=.15;ms[i].material.staticFriction=.15 end end
 rb.constraints=U.RigidbodyConstraints.FreezeRotation
 nextChoice=U.Time.time+2+math.random()*4
end
function FixedUpdate()
 if not rb then return end
 local now=U.Time.time;local dt=U.Time.fixedDeltaTime;local p=rb.position
 local a=DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor()
 if a then
  local ap=a.position;local v=previousActor and (ap-previousActor)/math.max(dt,.001) or U.Vector3.zero;previousActor=ap
  local d=p-ap;d.y=0
  local radius=a:IsSitting() and 1.85 or 1.4
  if d.magnitude<radius and math.abs(p.y-ap.y)<2.5 and v.magnitude>.1 and v.magnitude<30 then
   local away=d.magnitude>.02 and d.normalized or v.normalized
   if U.Vector3.Dot(v,away)>0 and now>=nextPush then rb:AddForce(away*math.min(2.5,v.magnitude*.7),U.ForceMode.VelocityChange);nextPush=now+.3;pushedUntil=now+1.5;target=nil end
  end
 end
 if now>=nextChoice and now>=pushedUntil then
  nextChoice=now+3+math.random()*5
  if math.random()<.5 then target=nil else
   local angle=math.random()*6.283;target=p+U.Vector3(math.cos(angle)*3,0,math.sin(angle)*3)
  end
 end
 if target and now>=pushedUntil then
  local d=target-p;d.y=0
  if d.magnitude<.35 then target=nil else
   local hits=U.Physics.RaycastAll(p+U.Vector3(0,.65,0),d.normalized,1.1,-1,U.QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore)
   local blocked=false
   for i=0,hits.Length-1 do local c=hits[i].collider;if c and not c.transform:IsChildOf(self.transform) and hits[i].normal.y<.5 then blocked=true end end
   if blocked then target=nil else
    local v=rb.velocity;local force=(d.normalized*.75-U.Vector3(v.x,0,v.z))*10
    rb:AddForce(force,U.ForceMode.Acceleration)
    local rotation=U.Quaternion.LookRotation(-d.normalized)
    rb:MoveRotation(U.Quaternion.Slerp(rb.rotation,rotation,dt*3))
   end
  end
 end
 local v=rb.velocity;play(v.x*v.x+v.z*v.z>.02 and 'Walk' or 'Idle')
end
function OnCollisionEnter(c)
 if rb and c.relativeVelocity.magnitude>.6 then pushedUntil=U.Time.time+1.5;target=nil end
end

---@id 3c2b8f2d-043c-43f5-a0bd-65e5d9a624b9
---@sourceScriptId f8282ad6-a565-4d4e-a7b9-6cd59266b13a
---@referenceName dragon_combat_rules.lua
-- Deterministic encounter simulation. No rendering, network or avatar side effects.
---@displayName 龙眠魔法阵战斗规则
local C={melee={hp=6,damage=2,range=2.8,interval=.55,windup=.23,skillDelay=.20,cooldown=8},mage={hp=5,damage=1,range=12,interval=.7,windup=.28,skillDelay=.65,cooldown=8},ranged={hp=5,damage=1,range=18,interval=.65,windup=.18,skillDelay=.38,cooldown=8}}
local function distance(x,z,a,b)return math.sqrt((x-a)^2+(z-b)^2)end
local function clamp(x,z,s,padding)
 local dx,dz=x-s.x,z-s.z;local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);local r=s.radius-(padding or 0)
 if d>r then return s.x+dx*r/d,s.z+dz*r/d end;return x,z
end
local function emit(s,kind,data)
 s.eventId=s.eventId+1;data=data or {};data.id=s.eventId;data.type=kind;data.time=s.t;s.events[#s.events+1]=data
 if #s.events>32 then table.remove(s.events,1)end
end
function Classes()return C end
function New(x,y,z,radius,epoch,duel)
 return {schema=1,duel=duel==true,epoch=epoch,x=x,y=y,z=z,radius=radius,t=0,phase='ready',members={},enemies={},shots={},queue={},events={},eventId=0,nextShot=0,prep=2}
end
function Join(s,id,class,pos)
 if not C[class]or not pos or s.phase~='ready' or s.members[id]then return false end
 if distance(pos.x,pos.z,s.x,s.z)>s.radius then return false end
 local hp=C[class].hp*(s.duel and 4 or 1)
 s.members[id]={id=id,class=class,hp=hp,maxHP=hp,damage=0,ack=0,attackUntil=0,skillUntil=0,busy=0,shield=0,invulnerable=0,x=pos.x,z=pos.z}
 return true
end
function Spawn(s)
 s.stage=(s.stage or 0)+1;s.nextEnemy=s.nextEnemy or 0
 local players=0;for _,m in pairs(s.members)do if m.hp>0 then players=players+1 end end
 local count=({4,5,3})[s.stage];local hpScale=1+math.max(0,players-1)*.55
 for i=1,count do local a=(i-1)*math.pi*2/count+s.stage*.6
  local boss=s.stage==3 and i==1;local elite=boss or(s.stage==2 and i>=4)
  local hp=math.ceil((boss and 30 or(elite and 12 or 7))*hpScale)
  s.nextEnemy=s.nextEnemy+1
  s.enemies[#s.enemies+1]={id=s.nextEnemy,x=s.x+math.sin(a)*7.5,z=s.z+math.cos(a)*7.5,hp=hp,maxHP=hp,speed=boss and 1.15 or(elite and 1.2 or 1.7),state='recover',timer=1+i*.2,hit=0,elite=elite,boss=boss}
 end
 s.phase='active';s.intermission=nil;emit(s,'begin',{stage=s.stage})
end
-- v15 对决：双人对战时，攻击目标是其他参战者而不是影灵
local function victims(s,owner)
 if not s.duel then return s.enemies end
 local list={}
 for id,m in pairs(s.members)do if id~=owner and m.hp>0 then m.id=id;m.player=true;list[#list+1]=m end end
 return list
end
local function target(s,m,dx,dz,range)
 local best,score=nil,-1e9
 for _,e in ipairs(victims(s,m.id))do if e.hp>0 then local x,z=e.x-m.x,e.z-m.z;local d=math.sqrt(x*x+z*z);local dot=d>.01 and(x*dx+z*dz)/d or 1
  if d<=range then local v=dot*3-d*.15;if v>score then best=e;score=v end end
 end end
 return best
end
function Aim(s,id,dx,dz,range)
 local m=s.members[id];if not m then return nil end;return target(s,m,dx,dz,range)
end
function Request(s,id,seq,kind,dx,dz)
 local m=s.members[id];if not m or (s.phase~='active'and not(kind=='retreat'and s.phase=='ready'))or m.hp<=0 or type(seq)~='number'or seq%1~=0 or seq<=m.ack then return false end
 m.ack=seq
 if kind=='retreat'then m.hp=0;m.retreat=true;return true end
 if kind=='skill'then kind='skill1'end
 local si=tonumber(string.match(kind or '', '^skill([123])$'));if kind~='attack'and not si then return false end
 if type(dx)~='number'or type(dz)~='number'or dx~=dx or dz~=dz then return false end
 local length=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);if length<.001 or length>2 then return false end;dx,dz=dx/length,dz/length
 local c=C[m.class];local cds={8,m.class=='mage'and 7 or 6,m.class=='mage'and 15 or 14};local delays=m.class=='mage'and{.65,.48,.95}or(m.class=='ranged'and{.38,.22,.65}or{.20,.22,.68})
 local key=si and(kind..'Until')or'attackUntil'
 if s.t<m.busy or s.t<(m[key]or 0)then return false end
 m[key]=s.t+(si and cds[si]or c.interval);m.busy=s.t+(si and(si==3 and 1.25 or 1)or c.interval)
 local e=target(s,m,dx,dz,c.range);if e and m.class~='melee'then local d=distance(e.x,e.z,m.x,m.z);if d>.01 then dx,dz=(e.x-m.x)/d,(e.z-m.z)/d end end
 local tx,tz=m.x+dx*6,m.z+dz*6;if e then tx,tz=e.x,e.z end
 local count=m.class=='ranged'and(si==1 and 5 or(si==3 and 3 or 1))or 1
 for i=1,count do s.queue[#s.queue+1]={at=s.t+(si and delays[si]or c.windup)+(i-1)*(si==3 and .32 or .16),owner=id,class=m.class,kind=kind,dx=dx,dz=dz,tx=tx,tz=tz,burst=i}end
 emit(s,'action',{owner=id,class=m.class,kind=kind,x=m.x,z=m.z,tx=tx,tz=tz});return true
end
local function damage(s,e,value,owner)
 if e.hp<=0 then return end
 if e.player then
  if s.t<(e.invulnerable or 0)or s.t<(e.shield or 0)then return end
  local amount=math.min(e.hp,value);e.hp=e.hp-amount;e.invulnerable=s.t+.3
  local m=s.members[owner];if m then m.damage=m.damage+amount end
  emit(s,'hurt',{owner=e.id,x=e.x,z=e.z,damage=amount})
  emit(s,'hit',{x=e.x,z=e.z,damage=amount,dead=e.hp<=0,class=m and m.class,owner=owner,enemyId=e.id})
  return
 end
 local amount=math.min(e.hp,value);e.hp=e.hp-amount;e.hit=s.t+.18
 local m=s.members[owner];if m then m.damage=m.damage+amount end
 emit(s,'hit',{x=e.x,z=e.z,damage=amount,dead=e.hp<=0,class=m and m.class,owner=owner,enemyId=e.id})
end
local function launch(s,q)
 local m=s.members[q.owner];if not m or m.hp<=0 then return end;local c=C[q.class]
 local si=tonumber(string.match(q.kind,'^skill([123])$'))
 if q.class=='melee'then
  if si==1 then m.shield=s.t+3 end
  for _,e in ipairs(victims(s,q.owner))do if e.hp>0 then
   local dx,dz=e.x-m.x,e.z-m.z;local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
   local reach=si==3 and 5 or(si and 3.5 or c.range)
   if d<=reach and(si==1 or si==2 or d<.01 or(dx*q.dx+dz*q.dz)/d>=.5)then
    if si==1 then if d>.01 then e.x,e.z=clamp(e.x+dx/d*2,e.z+dz/d*2,s,.7)end;e.state='stun';e.timer=.8
    else damage(s,e,si==3 and 5 or(si==2 and 3 or c.damage),q.owner)end
   end
  end end
  emit(s,'slash',{x=m.x,z=m.z,dx=q.dx,dz=q.dz,kind=q.kind,class=q.class})
 elseif(q.class=='mage'and si)or(q.class=='ranged'and si==3)then
  local tx,tz=clamp(q.tx,q.tz,s,.5);local d=distance(tx,tz,m.x,m.z);if d>10 then tx,tz=m.x+(tx-m.x)*10/d,m.z+(tz-m.z)*10/d end
  local radius=si==3 and 3.6 or 3
  emit(s,'area',{x=tx,z=tz,class=q.class,kind=q.kind,burst=q.burst})
  for _,e in ipairs(victims(s,q.owner))do if e.hp>0 and distance(e.x,e.z,tx,tz)<=radius then
   damage(s,e,q.class=='ranged'and 1 or(si==3 and 5 or(si==2 and 2 or 3)),q.owner)
   if q.class=='mage'and si==2 then e.state='stun';e.timer=2 end
  end end
 else
  s.nextShot=s.nextShot+1;s.shots[#s.shots+1]={id=s.nextShot,owner=q.owner,class=q.class,x=m.x,z=m.z,dx=q.dx,dz=q.dz,left=c.range,speed=q.class=='mage'and 16 or 24,damage=si==2 and 3 or c.damage,pierce=si==2,hitIds={}}
  emit(s,'shot',{x=m.x,z=m.z,dx=q.dx,dz=q.dz,class=q.class,kind=q.kind})
 end
end
local function segmentDistance(px,pz,ax,az,bx,bz)
 local dx,dz=bx-ax,bz-az;local len=dx*dx+dz*dz;local t=len>0 and math.max(0,math.min(1,((px-ax)*dx+(pz-az)*dz)/len))or 0
 return distance(px,pz,ax+dx*t,az+dz*t),t
end
function Step(s,dt,positions,blocked)
 if s.phase~='ready'and s.phase~='active'then return end;dt=math.max(0,math.min(.1,dt));s.t=s.t+dt
 local alive=0
 for id,m in pairs(s.members)do local p=positions[id]
  if p then m.x,m.z=clamp(p.x,p.z,s,.5);m.missing=0 else m.missing=(m.missing or 0)+dt;if m.missing>5 then m.hp=0 end end
  if m.hp>0 then alive=alive+1 end
 end
 if alive==0 then s.phase='defeat';emit(s,'defeat');return end
 if s.phase=='ready'then
  if s.duel then
   -- 对决：等第二个人进场，倒数三秒后开打；一个人等太久就散场
   local n=0;for _ in pairs(s.members)do n=n+1 end
   if n>=2 then s.readyAt=s.readyAt or s.t+3;if s.t>=s.readyAt then s.stage=1;s.phase='active';emit(s,'begin',{stage=1})end
   elseif s.t>120 then s.phase='defeat';emit(s,'defeat')end
  elseif s.t>=s.prep then Spawn(s)end
  return
 end
 if s.duel and alive<=1 then
  for id,m in pairs(s.members)do if m.hp>0 then s.winner=id end end
  s.queue={};s.shots={};s.phase='victory';emit(s,'victory',{winner=s.winner});return
 end
 for i=#s.queue,1,-1 do local q=s.queue[i];if q.at<=s.t then launch(s,q);table.remove(s.queue,i)end end
 for i=#s.shots,1,-1 do local q=s.shots[i];local step=math.min(q.left,q.speed*dt);local nx,nz=q.x+q.dx*step,q.z+q.dz*step;local hit,best=nil,2
  for _,e in ipairs(victims(s,q.owner))do if e.hp>0 and not q.hitIds[e.id]then local d,t=segmentDistance(e.x,e.z,q.x,q.z,nx,nz);if d<((e.elite or e.player) and .8 or .5)and t<best then hit=e;best=t end end end
  local wall=blocked and blocked(q.x,q.z,nx,nz)
  if hit and not wall then damage(s,hit,q.damage,q.owner);q.hitIds[hit.id]=true end
  q.left=q.left-step;q.x,q.z=nx,nz
  if (hit and not q.pierce)or wall or q.left<=0 or distance(nx,nz,s.x,s.z)>s.radius then table.remove(s.shots,i)end
 end
 local enemiesAlive=0
 for _,e in ipairs(s.enemies)do if e.hp>0 then
  enemiesAlive=enemiesAlive+1;local closest,dist=nil,1e9
  for id,m in pairs(s.members)do if m.hp>0 then local d=distance(e.x,e.z,m.x,m.z);if d<dist then closest=m;dist=d end end end
  if closest then
   -- Authority owns facing; freeze aim through windup/lunge/recovery so dodges remain readable.
   if e.state=='chase'or not e.faceX then local dx,dz=closest.x-e.x,closest.z-e.z;local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);if d>.001 then e.faceX,e.faceZ=dx/d,dz/d end end
   if e.state=='windup'then e.timer=e.timer-dt;if e.timer<=0 then
    e.state='lunge';e.timer=.28;e.lungeStartX=e.x;e.lungeStartZ=e.z
    emit(s,'strike',{x=e.x,z=e.z,enemyId=e.id})
   end
   elseif e.state=='lunge'then
    e.timer=math.max(0,e.timer-dt);local t=1-e.timer/.28
    e.x,e.z=clamp(e.lungeStartX+(e.tx-e.lungeStartX)*t,e.lungeStartZ+(e.tz-e.lungeStartZ)*t,s,.7)
    if e.timer<=0 then
     for id,m in pairs(s.members)do if m.hp>0 and distance(e.x,e.z,m.x,m.z)<(e.boss and 2.1 or 1.35)and s.t>=m.invulnerable and s.t>=m.shield then
      local amount=math.min(m.hp,e.elite and 2 or 1);m.hp=m.hp-amount;m.invulnerable=s.t+.85
      emit(s,'hurt',{owner=id,x=m.x,z=m.z,damage=amount})
     end end
     e.state='recover';e.timer=e.boss and 1.25 or 1.5
    end
   elseif e.state=='recover'or e.state=='stun'then e.timer=e.timer-dt;if e.timer<=0 then e.state='chase'end
   elseif dist<(e.boss and 3 or 2.3)then e.state='windup';e.timer=e.elite and 1.1 or .8;e.attackStart=s.t;e.attackDuration=e.timer;local dx,dz=closest.x-e.x,closest.z-e.z;local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);e.tx,e.tz=closest.x,closest.z;if d>.9 then e.tx,e.tz=closest.x-dx/d*.9,closest.z-dz/d*.9 end;emit(s,'tell',{x=e.tx,z=e.tz})
   elseif dist>.01 then local step=math.min(dist-1.3,e.speed*dt);e.x,e.z=clamp(e.x+(closest.x-e.x)/dist*step,e.z+(closest.z-e.z)/dist*step,s,.7)end
  end
 end end
 if enemiesAlive==0 and not s.duel then
  s.queue={};s.shots={}
  if s.stage<3 then
   if not s.intermission then s.intermission=s.t+3;emit(s,'reinforcement',{stage=s.stage+1})end
   if s.t>=s.intermission then for _,m in pairs(s.members)do if m.hp>0 then m.hp=math.min(m.maxHP,m.hp+1)end end;Spawn(s)end
  else s.phase='victory';emit(s,'victory')end
 end
end
function Boundary(s,x,z)return clamp(x,z,s,.5)end

local U=CS.UnityEngine
local V=U.Vector3
local Q=U.Quaternion
local json=dkjson
local scope=require('official.core.runtime_scope').from(self)
-- mobile-v21: resolve each dependency at most once a second, at most 30 attempts.
do
 local target=scope
 local original=target.GetScript
 local memo,attempts,nextAt={},{},{}
 local failures={}
 target.GetScript=function(_,name)
  if memo[name] then return memo[name] end
  local now=CS.UnityEngine.Time.realtimeSinceStartup
  if (attempts[name] or 0)>=30 or now<(nextAt[name] or 0) then return nil end
  attempts[name]=(attempts[name] or 0)+1;nextAt[name]=now+1
  local ok,value=pcall(original,target,name)
  if ok and value then memo[name]=value;return value end
  if attempts[name]==30 then failures[name]=tostring(value or 'not loaded');print('[mobile-v21] dependency failed: '..name..' '..failures[name]) end
  return nil
 end
 function GetDependencyDiagnostics() return {build='mobile-v21',attempts=attempts,failures=failures} end
 local destroy=OnDestroy
 -- Installed after lifecycle definitions below; clears references on scene exit.
 ReleaseMobileDependencies=function()memo={};attempts={};nextAt={};failures={} end
end

local Spawn=require('official.core.spawn')
local engine,rpg,fx,rules
local state=nil
local netReady=false
local previewCenter=nil
local visuals={}
local shadowReady={source=nil,attempts=0,nextAt=0,status='pending',error=nil,spawnAttempts={}}
local function shadowSource()
 if shadowReady.source then return shadowReady.source end
 local now=U.Time.realtimeSinceStartup
 if shadowReady.attempts>=30 or now<shadowReady.nextAt then return nil end
 shadowReady.attempts=shadowReady.attempts+1;shadowReady.nextAt=now+1
 local go=scope:GetGameObjectByPath('ShadowSpiritSource')
 if go then
  local rs=go:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(U.Renderer),true)
  for i=0,rs.Length-1 do
   local skin=rs[i].gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(U.SkinnedMeshRenderer))
   local mesh=rs[i].gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(U.MeshFilter))
   if (skin and skin.sharedMesh)or(mesh and mesh.sharedMesh)then shadowReady.source=go;shadowReady.status='ready';return go end
  end
 end
 if shadowReady.attempts==30 then shadowReady.status='failed';shadowReady.error='shadow mesh not loaded';print('[mobile-v21] shadow source failed')end
 return nil
end
function GetShadowDiagnostics()
 local count=0;for _,v in pairs(visuals)do if v.go and v.go.activeInHierarchy then count=count+1 end end
 return {build='mobile-v21',source=shadowReady.status,error=shadowReady.error,attempts=shadowReady.attempts,visible=count}
end

local seenEvent=0
local seenEpoch=nil
local published=0
local serial=0
local pending={}
local resolved={}
local flyWas=nil
local lastActive=false
local function id(a)return tostring(a.actorID)end
local function localActor()return CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor()end
local function authority()return netReady and CS.DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled and self:HasOwnership()end
local function ground(x,z,a)
 -- v15：先读地形高度（射线会打到树冠、麦子甚至天空罩，魔法阵就飘到看不见的地方去了）
 local okT,hT=pcall(function()local t=U.Terrain.activeTerrain;return t:SampleHeight(V(x,0,z))+t.transform.position.y end)
 if okT and hT and hT>1 then return hT end
 local hits=U.Physics.RaycastAll(V(x,400,z),V.down,600,1,U.QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore)
 local y=a.position.y;local nearest=1e9
 for i=0,hits.Length-1 do local hit=hits[i];if hit.normal.y>.45 and hit.distance<nearest then y=hit.point.y;nearest=hit.distance end end
 return y
end
local function center(a)
 if PreviewMode then if not previewCenter then local p=a.position;previewCenter=V(p.x,ground(p.x,p.z+3,a),p.z+3)end;return previewCenter end
 return V(ArenaX,ground(ArenaX,ArenaZ,a),ArenaZ)

do
 local target=scope

 local memo,attempts,nextAt={},{},{}
 local failures={}
 target.GetScript=function(_,name)
  if memo[name] then return memo[name] end
  local now=CS.UnityEngine.Time.realtimeSinceStartup
  if (attempts[name] or 0)>=30 or now<(nextAt[name] or 0) then return nil end
  attempts[name]=(attempts[name] or 0)+1;nextAt[name]=now+1
  local ok,value=pcall(original,target,name)
  if ok and value then memo[name]=value;return value end
  if attempts[name]==30 then failures[name]=tostring(value or 'not loaded');print('[mobile-v21] dependency failed: '..name..' '..failures[name]) end
  return nil
 end

 if not net or not self:HasOwnership()or type(raw)~='string'or #raw>400 then return end
 local q=dkjson.decode(raw);if not q or type(q.id)~='string'then return end
 if q.k=='claim'then
  if dragonBusy(q.id)then return end
  dragon={id=q.id,at=now(),x=q.x or 0,y=q.y or 0,z=q.z or 0,yaw=q.yaw or 0,idle=1}
 elseif q.k=='pose'then
  if not dragon or dragon.id~=q.id then return end
  dragon={id=q.id,at=now(),x=q.x,y=q.y,z=q.z,yaw=q.yaw,idle=q.idle}
 elseif q.k=='release'then
  if not dragon or dragon.id~=q.id then return end

 else return end

end

end

end

 local minutes=((state.day and 360 or 1080)+math.min(720,math.max(0,now()-state.at)))%1440

 if exploration and exploration.IsBattleActive()then return false,'战斗结束后才能切换昼夜'end
 local a=CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor();if not a then return false,'角色尚未就绪'end

end

 if exploration and exploration.IsBattleActive()then return end
 local a=CS.DouyinActorService.GetActorById(tonumber(actorId)or -1)
 local dial=U.GameObject.Find('time_dial');if not a or not dial or U.Vector3.Distance(a.position,dial.transform.position)>6 then return end

 if not main then main=scope:GetScript('dragon_world_bridge.lua');exploration=scope:GetScript('dragon_exploration.lua')end
 if net and CS.DouyinNetService.isNetworkSettled and self:HasOwnership()and not state then state={day=false,at=now(),version=1};DayState:SetValue(dkjson.encode(state))end
 local fighting=exploration and exploration.IsBattleActive()
 if state and net and self:HasOwnership()and battleWas and not fighting and not state.day and now()-state.at>=600 then
  -- 刚打完一场：黑夜至少再留两分钟，魔法阵不会一退出就消失
  state={day=false,at=now()-600,version=state.version+1};DayState:SetValue(dkjson.encode(state))

  state={day=not state.day,at=now(),version=state.version+1};DayState:SetValue(dkjson.encode(state))
 end
 if main and not dragonRegistered then dragonRegistered=true;main.RegisterScript('cycle',{IsDay=IsDay,GetWorldClock=GetWorldClock,DragonClaim=DragonClaim,DragonPose=DragonPose,DragonRelease=DragonRelease,DragonOwner=DragonOwner,DragonRemote=DragonRemote})end

local U=CS.UnityEngine

local scope=require('official.core.runtime_scope').from(self)
-- mobile-v21: resolve each dependency at most once a second, at most 30 attempts.
do
 local target=scope
 local original=target.GetScript
 local memo,attempts,nextAt={},{},{}
 local failures={}
 target.GetScript=function(_,name)
  if memo[name] then return memo[name] end
  local now=CS.UnityEngine.Time.realtimeSinceStartup
  if (attempts[name] or 0)>=30 or now<(nextAt[name] or 0) then return nil end
  attempts[name]=(attempts[name] or 0)+1;nextAt[name]=now+1
  local ok,value=pcall(original,target,name)
  if ok and value then memo[name]=value;return value end
  if attempts[name]==30 then failures[name]=tostring(value or 'not loaded');print('[mobile-v21] dependency failed: '..name..' '..failures[name]) end
  return nil
 end
 function GetDependencyDiagnostics() return {build='mobile-v21',attempts=attempts,failures=failures} end
 local destroy=OnDestroy
 -- Installed after lifecycle definitions below; clears references on scene exit.
 ReleaseMobileDependencies=function()memo={};attempts={};nextAt={};failures={} end
end

function OpenContract(respec,continuation)
 -- Stable dependency: do not rescan the whole resource after every UI close.
 if not contractRpg then contractRpg=scope:GetScript('dragon_rpg.lua')end
 local rpg=contractRpg
 -- Reconcile the owner with the actual shared page, including interrupted closes.
 if rpg and rpg.IsContractOpen and not rpg.IsContractOpen()then
  contractSession=nil
  if mode=='class'then mode=nil end
 end
 if mode or contractSession or unavailable()or not rpg then return false,'gate: mode='..tostring(mode)..' session='..tostring(contractSession~=nil)..' unavailable='..tostring(unavailable())..' rpg='..tostring(rpg~=nil) end
 -- A contract owns the interaction until it closes. Recreate the native
 -- entry afterwards instead of retaining the button used to open it.
 local session={}
 contractSession=session;mode='class'
 clearNativeInteraction()
 if main then main.SetExplorationMenu(true)end
 local function finish()
  if contractSession~=session then return end
  contractSession=nil;mode=nil
  clearNativeInteraction()
  if main then main.SetExplorationMenu(false)end
  if actor then actor:Immobilize(false)end
 end
 local ok,opened=pcall(function()
  return rpg.OpenContract(respec,function()
   if contractSession~=session then return end
   finish()
   if continuation then continuation()end
  end)
 end)
 if not ok or not opened then
  finish()
  if not ok then toast('誓约之书暂时未能打开，请重试')end
  return false,'open: '..tostring(ok)..' '..tostring(opened)
 end
 return true
end

local function discover()

 if not altarPlaced then
  local altar=U.GameObject.Find('altar3')

   local p=altar.transform.position;local y=p.y+.4
   local hits=U.Physics.RaycastAll(V(p.x,p.y+20,p.z),V.down,25,-1,U.QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore)
   for i=0,hits.Length-1 do local h=hits[i];if h.point.y>y and h.point.y<p.y+5 and h.normal.y>.6 then y=h.point.y end end
   local all=U.Resources.FindObjectsOfTypeAll(typeof(U.Transform))
   for i=0,all.Length-1 do local t=all[i];if string.match(t.name,'^tripo_egg_stage_[0-3]$')and t.gameObject.scene:IsValid()then t.position=V(p.x,y+.08,p.z)end end
   local rune=U.GameObject.Find('rune_0');if rune then local stone=U.Object.Instantiate(rune);stone.name='DragonPactMemorial';stone.transform.position=V(127,73.22,193.2);stone.transform.localScale=rune.transform.lossyScale*.55 end
   altarPlaced=true

 end
 if not witchPlaced then
  local house=U.GameObject.Find('witch_shop_v2');local witch=U.GameObject.Find('tripo_witch')
  local staff=U.GameObject.Find('tripo_witch_staff');if staff then staff:SetActive(false)end
  local bottle=U.GameObject.Find('tripo_potion');if house and bottle then bottle.transform.position=house.transform.position+V(1,.65,.5)end
  if house and witch then witch.transform.position=house.transform.position+V(0,.15,0);witchPlaced=true end
 end

 end

 end

 local all=U.Resources.FindObjectsOfTypeAll(typeof(U.Transform))
 for j=0,all.Length-1 do local t=all[j];local i=tonumber(string.match(t.name,'^tripo_egg_stage_(%d)$'))

-- Streamed interaction objects can arrive after the first discovery pass.
-- Append missing targets without rebuilding live native button identities.
local function pollInteractionResources()
 if #targets==0 then return end
 if not R.pendingTargets then
  R.pendingTargets={{'holy_tree3','tree',9,'古树 · 重新立誓'},{'tripo_witch','witch',2.8,'女巫 · 调制'},{'camp','camp',4,'篝火 · 烤蘑菇'}}
  for i=0,35 do R.pendingTargets[#R.pendingTargets+1]={i==0 and 'mush'or 'mush_'..i,'mushroom',3.5,'采集蘑菇'}end
  for i=0,8 do R.pendingTargets[#R.pendingTargets+1]={'sheep_'..i,'wool',3,'取羊毛'}end
  R.foundTargets={};for _,t in ipairs(targets)do if t.go then R.foundTargets[t.go.name]=true end end
  R.targetUntil=U.Time.realtimeSinceStartup+30;R.targetAt=0;R.targetIndex=0
 end
 local now=U.Time.realtimeSinceStartup
 if now>R.targetUntil or now<R.targetAt then return end;R.targetAt=now+.1
 for _=1,2 do
  R.targetIndex=R.targetIndex%#R.pendingTargets+1;local q=R.pendingTargets[R.targetIndex]
  if not R.foundTargets[q[1]]then local go=U.GameObject.Find(q[1]);if go then targets[#targets+1]={go=go,kind=q[2],radius=q[3],label=q[4]};R.foundTargets[q[1]]=true end end
 end
end
local function handleNativeClick(index)
 if not nativeExplore or not nativeTarget or nativeTarget~=current then return end
 local now=U.Time.unscaledTime
 if now-lastNativeClick<.25 then return end
 lastNativeClick=now
 if index==1 then interact()elseif index==2 and nativePotion then drinkMystery()end
end
local function queueNativeClick(index)
 -- Keep the native button alive until the engine has completed click dispatch.
 if queuedNative or not nativeTarget or nativeTarget~=current then return end
 queuedNative={index=index,target=nativeTarget,frame=U.Time.frameCount}
end
function OnInteractorButtonClick(index)queueNativeClick(index)end

function GetStatus()return{loaded=progress and progress.IsLoaded(),mode=mode,target=current and current.kind,targets=#targets,potion=potion and potion.kind,buff=buff and buff.kind,eggStage=eggStage,lore=lore.n,bridge=main~=nil,roastX=R.x,roastZone=R.zoneX,roastW=R.zoneW}end
function DebugOpen(kind,id)if kind=='cook'then cook()elseif kind=='lore'then readLore(id or 1)elseif kind=='tasks'then OpenTasks()elseif kind=='serve'then roastPress()elseif kind=='buff'then applyBuff(id)end end
function Update()
 if not progress then progress=scope:GetScript('dragon_progress.lua');rules=scope:GetScript('dragon_progress_rules.lua');cycle=scope:GetScript('dragon_daycycle.lua');main=scope:GetScript('dragon_world_bridge.lua')end
 if not progress or not rules or not cycle or not main then progress=nil;return end
 if not R.registered then R.registered=true;main.RegisterScript('explore',{OpenTasks=OpenTasks,IsBattleActive=IsBattleActive,GetLoreCount=GetLoreCount})end
 actor=CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor();if not actor or not buildUI()then return end
 if U.Time.time-lastScan>5 then lastScan=U.Time.time;if #targets==0 then discover()end end
 pollInteractionResources()
 local p=progress.GetProfile()
 if not p then return end
 if queuedNative and U.Time.frameCount>queuedNative.frame then
  local click=queuedNative;queuedNative=nil
  if click.target==nativeTarget and click.target==current then handleNativeClick(click.index)end
 end
 local world=main.GetExplorationState();local available=world=='play'and not unavailable()
 current=nil;local best=1e9
 for _,t in ipairs(targets)do if nearby(t)then local pos=t.go and t.go.transform.position or t.position;local d=V.Distance(actor.position,pos);if d<best then current=t;best=d end end end
 local wanted=available and not mode and current or nil
 if wanted~=nativeTarget then
  clearNativeInteraction()
  nativeTarget=wanted
  if wanted then
   nativeExplore=self:AddInteractorButton();nativeExplore.onClick:AddListener(function()queueNativeClick(1)end)
   if wanted.kind=='witch'then nativePotion=self:AddInteractorButton();nativePotion.onClick:AddListener(function()queueNativeClick(2)end) end
  end
 end
 if nativeExplore and wanted then local label=nativeExplore:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(U.UI.Text),true);if label then label.text=wanted.kind=='witch'and '调制星露'or wanted.label end end
 if nativePotion then local label=nativePotion:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(U.UI.Text),true);if label then label.text='饮用神秘药水'end end
 if pendingClass then main.ApplySavedClass(pendingClass);pendingClass=nil end
 if not firstReady then firstReady=true;main.ApplySavedClass(p.class)end
 local stage=rules.EggStage(p)
 if stage~=eggStage then for i,e in pairs(eggs)do e.go:SetActive(i==stage)end;eggStage=stage end
 if hatchStart then
  -- 蛋抖三秒，然后龙魂离壳
  local age=U.Time.time-hatchStart;local e=eggs[2];if e then e.go.transform.localScale=e.scale*(1+.03*math.sin(age*14)*math.min(1,age))end
  if age>3 and not progress.GetStatus().pending then
   if e then e.go.transform.localScale=e.scale end
   hatchStart=nil
   submit('hatch',{},function()if main then main.DragonAwaken()end end)
  end
 end
 updateRoast()
 if buff then
  if U.Time.time>=buff.untilTime or mounted()then restoreBuff()end
 end
 if buffHud then
  buffHud.go:SetActive(buff~=nil and not mode)
  if buff then
   if buffHud.kind~=buff.kind then buffHud.kind=buff.kind;K.set(buffHud.label,buff.kind=='speed'and 'buff_speed'or 'buff_dizzy',1)end
   buffHud.num.set(tostring(math.max(0,math.ceil(buff.untilTime-U.Time.time))))
  end
 end
 if potion then
  local moved=lastPosition and V.Distance(actor.position,lastPosition)>8
  if U.Time.time>=potion.untilTime or unavailable()or moved then restorePotion()
  elseif potion.sheep then
   for _,entry in ipairs(potion.hidden)do if entry.r then entry.r.enabled=false end end
   potion.sheep.transform.position=actor.position;potion.sheep.transform.rotation=actor.rotation*potion.sheepRotation
 elseif potion.light then potion.light.transform.position=actor.position+V(math.sin(U.Time.time*2)*.6,1.2,math.cos(U.Time.time*2)*.6)end
 end
 lastPosition=actor.position
 if mode and unavailable()then callback=nil;hatchStart=nil;Close()end
end
function OnApplicationFocus(focused)if not focused then restorePotion()end end
function OnDisable()queuedNative=nil;contractSession=nil;mode=nil;clearNativeInteraction();restorePotion();restoreBuff();callback=nil;if root then root:SetActive(false)end;if main then main.SetExplorationMenu(false)end end
function OnDestroy()OnDisable();if root then U.Object.Destroy(root)end end

local function sound(name,gain)
 local now=U.Time.time;if audioLastTime[name]and now-audioLastTime[name]<.07 then return end
 local c=audioConfig()[name];local clip=c and c[1]
 if not clip then audioFailed=audioFailed+1;logger:warnOnce('missing-'..name,'audio asset unavailable',name);return end
 if c[2]<=0 or c[3]<=0 then return end
 local actor=CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor()
 if not actor then return end
 if not audioRoot then audioRoot=U.GameObject('DragonCombatAudio')end
 local source=nil
 for _,v in ipairs(audioPool)do if not v.isPlaying then source=v;break end end
 local limit=MobileBudget and 4 or 8
 if not source and #audioPool<limit then local go=U.GameObject('CombatVoice'..#audioPool);go.transform:SetParent(audioRoot.transform,false);source=go:AddComponent(typeof(U.AudioSource));source.playOnAwake=false;source.spatialBlend=1;source.rolloffMode=U.AudioRolloffMode.Linear;source.loop=false;audioPool[#audioPool+1]=source end
 if not source then return end
 source.transform.position=actor.position;source.minDistance=math.min(2,c[3]*.1);source.maxDistance=c[3]
 source.volume=math.max(0,math.min(1,c[2]));source.mute=false;source.pitch=1;source:PlayOneShot(clip,gain or 1)
 audioLastTime[name]=now;audioPlayed=audioPlayed+1;audioLast=name
end
local originalSources={}
local function originalSound(kind,position)
 local config={Bow={BowSound,BowSoundVolume,BowSoundMaxDistance},Enemy={EnemySound,EnemySoundVolume,EnemySoundMaxDistance},Hurt={HurtSound,HurtSoundVolume,HurtSoundMaxDistance}}
 local c=config[kind];if not c or not c[1]or c[2]<=0 or c[3]<=0 then return end
 local v=originalSources[kind]
 if not v then local go=U.GameObject('OriginalCombatAudio_'..kind);local source=go:AddComponent(typeof(U.AudioSource));source.playOnAwake=false;source.spatialBlend=1;source.rolloffMode=U.AudioRolloffMode.Linear;v={go=go,source=source};originalSources[kind]=v end
 if v.clip~=c[1]then v.source:Stop();v.clip=c[1]end
 v.go.transform.position=position;v.source.volume=math.max(0,math.min(1,c[2]));v.source.minDistance=math.min(2,c[3]*.1);v.source.maxDistance=c[3];v.source:PlayOneShot(c[1]);audioPlayed=audioPlayed+1;audioLast='original-'..kind
end
local hurtFeel=nil

local flying={}

-- v15：特效整体放大、叠层、带余爆；大招带屏幕闪光和镜头震动
local BOOM=1.55
local later={}
local bridge=nil
local scope15=require('official.core.runtime_scope').from(self)
-- mobile-v21: resolve each dependency at most once a second, at most 30 attempts.
do
 local target=scope15
 local original=target.GetScript
 local memo,attempts,nextAt={},{},{}
 local failures={}
 target.GetScript=function(_,name)
  if memo[name] then return memo[name] end
  local now=CS.UnityEngine.Time.realtimeSinceStartup
  if (attempts[name] or 0)>=30 or now<(nextAt[name] or 0) then return nil end
  attempts[name]=(attempts[name] or 0)+1;nextAt[name]=now+1
  local ok,value=pcall(original,target,name)
  if ok and value then memo[name]=value;return value end
  if attempts[name]==30 then failures[name]=tostring(value or 'not loaded');print('[mobile-v21] dependency failed: '..name..' '..failures[name]) end
  return nil
 end
 function GetDependencyDiagnostics() return {build='mobile-v21',attempts=attempts,failures=failures} end
 local destroy=OnDestroy
 -- Installed after lifecycle definitions below; clears references on scene exit.
 ReleaseMobileDependencies=function()memo={};attempts={};nextAt={};failures={} end
end

local function feel(flash,shake,duration)
 if not bridge then bridge=scope15:GetScript('dragon_world_bridge.lua')end
 if bridge then pcall(function()bridge.ScreenFx(flash,shake,duration or .35)end)end
end
local function one(key,p,rotation,scale)
 if not key then return end
 local go,why=Effect.spawn(self,key,p,{rotation=rotation or U.Quaternion.identity,scale=(scale or 1)*BOOM})
 if go then emitted=emitted+1 else failed=failed+1;lastReason=why end
end
hurtFeel=function()if not bridge then bridge=scope15:GetScript('dragon_world_bridge.lua')end;if bridge then pcall(function()bridge.ScreenFx(.3,.6,.3,true)end)end end
local function after(delay,fn)later[#later+1]={at=U.Time.time+delay,fn=fn}end
local function ring(key,p,count,radius,scale,y)
 if MobileBudget then count=math.max(2,math.ceil(count*.4))end
 for i=1,count do local a=i*math.pi*2/count+radius;one(key,p+V(math.cos(a)*radius,y or .1,math.sin(a)*radius),nil,scale)end
end
local function projectile(key,p,d,speed,life,pierce,scale)
 if not key or #flying>=(MobileBudget and 10 or 26) then return end
 local h,why=Effect.create(self,key,p,{rotation=U.Quaternion.LookRotation(d,V.up),scale=scale or 1.5})
 if not h then failed=failed+1;lastReason=why;return end
 emitted=emitted+1
 flying[#flying+1]={h=h,p=p,d=d,speed=speed,start=U.Time.time,life=life,pierce=pierce,stop=false}
end
function Charge(kind,action,p,target)
 if action=='attack'then return end
 if kind=='mage'and action=='skill3'then
  sound('v2-meteor-fall');local start=target+V(-3,14,-2)
  for i=0,2 do after(i*.12,function()projectile(BoltEffect,start+V(i*.8,i*1.2,0),(target-start).normalized,16,.95,false,2.6)end)end
  one(TellEffect,V(target.x,target.y-.5,target.z),nil,2.6)
 elseif kind=='mage'then one(HitEffect,p+V(0,.6,0),nil,1.3)
 elseif kind=='ranged'and action=='skill3'then sound('v2-rain-fall');one(TellEffect,V(target.x,target.y-.5,target.z),nil,2.4)
 elseif kind=='melee'and action=='skill3'then sound('v2-giant-awaken',.8);one(ShieldEffect,p-V(0,.45,0),nil,1.1);ring(HitEffect,p,6,1.4,.9,.4)
 elseif kind=='ranged'and action=='skill2'then sound('v2-leaf-charge',.75);one(HitEffect,p,nil,1.2)end
end
function Area(kind,action,p,burst)
 if kind=='ranged'then
  sound('v2-rain-hit',.8)
  for i=1,12 do local a=i*2.39996;local radius=.5+(i%4)*.8;local at=p+V(math.cos(a)*radius,0,math.sin(a)*radius)
   after(i*.035,function()projectile(ArrowEffect,at+V(0,7,0),V.down,34,.2,false,1.6);one(HitEffect,at,nil,1)end)
  end
  after(.45,function()one(BlastEffect,p,nil,1.3);ring(HitEffect,p,8,3,.9)end)
  feel(.16,.5,.45)
 elseif action=='skill2'then
  sound('v2-time-hit');one(FrostEffect,p,nil,1.9);ring(FrostEffect,p,5,2.4,.7)
  for i=1,10 do local a=i*math.pi/5;projectile(BoltEffect,p+V(0,.3,0),V(math.cos(a),.2,math.sin(a)),7,.5,false,1.3)end
  after(.25,function()one(FrostEffect,p,nil,1.2)end)
  feel(.14,.35,.3)
 elseif action=='skill3'then
  sound('v2-meteor-impact');one(MeteorEffect,p,nil,2.6);one(BlastEffect,p,nil,2.4);ring(HitEffect,p,10,2.6,1.4)
  after(.18,function()ring(BlastEffect,p,5,3.2,1.1);sound('v2-cannon-explode',.7)end)
  after(.4,function()ring(HitEffect,p,12,4.4,1.1);one(MeteorEffect,p,nil,1.5)end)
  feel(.4,1.4,.7)
 else
  sound('v2-magic-burst');one(BlastEffect,p,nil,2.1);ring(HitEffect,p,7,1.9,1.1)
  after(.16,function()one(BlastEffect,p+V(0,.4,0),nil,1.2);ring(HitEffect,p,5,3,.8)end)
  feel(.2,.6,.4)
 end
end
function Play(kind,action,origin,direction)
 local d=direction.sqrMagnitude>.001 and direction.normalized or V.forward
 local q=U.Quaternion.LookRotation(d,V.up)
 if action=='skill'then action='skill1'end
 if kind=='melee'then
  if action=='skill1'then
   sound('v2-giant-hit',.8);one(ShieldEffect,origin-V(0,.45,0),nil,2.3);ring(HitEffect,origin,8,2.6,1)
   after(.15,function()one(ShieldEffect,origin-V(0,.45,0),nil,3.2)end);feel(.18,.6,.4)
  elseif action=='skill2'then
   sound('v2-sword-swing')
   for i=0,5 do after(i*.05,function()one(SlashEffect,origin+V(0,.1*(i%2),0),q*U.Quaternion.Euler(0,i*60,i%2==0 and 12 or -12),1.7)end)end
   after(.2,function()ring(HitEffect,origin,8,3,1)end);feel(.1,.45,.35)
  elseif action=='skill3'then
   sound('v2-giant-hit')
   one(SlashEffect,origin,q*U.Quaternion.Euler(0,0,85),2.6);one(SlashEffect,origin,q*U.Quaternion.Euler(0,0,95),2.1)
   local hit=origin+d*2.6
   one(ShieldEffect,hit-V(0,.45,0),nil,2);one(BlastEffect,hit,nil,1.6);one(MeteorEffect,hit,nil,1.3)
   after(.12,function()for i=1,4 do one(HitEffect,origin+d*(1.5+i*1.1)-V(0,.3,0),nil,1.5)end;sound('v2-wall-break',.7)end)
   feel(.34,1.2,.6)
  else
   sound('v2-sword-swing');one(SlashEffect,origin+V(0,.05,0),q,1.45);one(SlashEffect,origin+V(0,.25,0),q*U.Quaternion.Euler(0,0,24),1.1)
  end
 elseif kind=='mage'then
  if action~='attack'then Area(kind,action,origin+d*6,1)else sound('v2-magic-shot',.8);one(HitEffect,origin+d*.6,nil,.9);projectile(BoltEffect,origin,d,18,.75,false,1.8)end
 else
  if action=='skill3'then Area(kind,action,origin+d*6,1)
  elseif action=='skill1'then for i=0,4 do queued[#queued+1]={at=U.Time.time+i*.16,p=origin,d=(q*U.Quaternion.Euler(0,(i-2)*3.5,0))*V.forward}end
  else originalSound('Bow',origin);one(HitEffect,origin+d*.5,nil,.7);projectile(ArrowEffect,origin,d,26,.75,action=='skill2',action=='skill2'and 2.4 or 1.6)
   if action=='skill2'then projectile(ArrowEffect,origin+V(0,.12,0),d,26,.75,true,2);projectile(BoltEffect,origin,d,26,.75,true,1.2);feel(.08,.3,.25)end end
 end
end
function Impact(kind,position,amount,class)
 if kind=='tell'then one(TellEffect,V(position.x,position.y-.5,position.z),nil,1.25)
 elseif kind=='blast'then one(BlastEffect,position,nil,1.6)
 elseif kind=='hit'then
  sound(class=='mage'and'v2-magic-hit'or(class=='ranged'and'v2-arrow-hit'or'v2-sword-hit'),.8)
  local big=(amount or 0)>=3
  one(HitEffect,position,nil,big and 1.8 or 1.25)
  if class=='mage'then one(BlastEffect,position,nil,big and 1.1 or .6)
  elseif class=='melee'then one(SlashEffect,position,U.Quaternion.Euler(0,math.random()*360,60),big and 1.2 or .8)
  else ring(HitEffect,position,3,.5,.6,.2)end
  if big then feel(.1,.4,.25)end
  -- End only nearby cosmetic flights; authoritative hit/damage lives in combat rules.
  for _,v in ipairs(flying)do
   if not v.stop then
    local age=U.Time.time-v.start;local p=v.p+v.d*(v.speed*math.min(age,v.life))
    if not v.pierce and (p-position).sqrMagnitude<1.5 then v.h:Stop();v.stop=true;v.release=U.Time.time+.35 end
   end
  end
 elseif kind=='strike'then originalSound('Enemy',position);one(HitEffect,V(position.x,position.y-.4,position.z),nil,.9)end
end
function SetArena(center,radius,visible)
 if not visible then wantedArena=nil;if arena then arena:Release();arena=nil;arenaKey=nil end;return end
 wantedArena={p=center,r=radius}
 if arenaKey~=ArenaEffect and arena then arena:Release();arena=nil end
 if not arena and ArenaEffect and U.Time.time>=arenaRetry then
  local why;arena,why=Effect.create(self,ArenaEffect,center,{scale=radius})
  arenaRetry=U.Time.time+.5
  if arena then arenaKey=ArenaEffect else lastReason=why end
 end
end
function Update()
 local now=U.Time.time
 for i=#queued,1,-1 do local q=queued[i];if now>=q.at then originalSound('Bow',q.p);projectile(ArrowEffect,q.p,q.d,26,.75,false,1.6);table.remove(queued,i)end end
 for i=#later,1,-1 do local q=later[i];if now>=q.at then table.remove(later,i);pcall(q.fn)end end
 for i=#flying,1,-1 do
  local v=flying[i];local age=now-v.start
  if not v.stop then
   local go=v.h:GetGameObject()
   if go then go.transform.position=v.p+v.d*(v.speed*math.min(age,v.life))end
   if age>=v.life then v.h:Stop();v.stop=true;v.release=now+.4 end
  elseif now>=v.release then v.h:Release();table.remove(flying,i)end
 end
 if wantedArena and not arena then SetArena(wantedArena.p,wantedArena.r,true)end
end
function GetStatus()
 local playing=0;for _,s in ipairs(audioPool)do if s.isPlaying then playing=playing+1 end end
 return{audio={played=audioPlayed,failed=audioFailed,last=audioLast,playing=playing,warmed=warmIndex-1},available=Effect.isAvailable(),emitted=emitted,failed=failed,lastReason=lastReason,flying=#flying,arena=arena~=nil,refs={frost=FrostEffect~=nil,meteor=MeteorEffect~=nil,slash=SlashEffect~=nil,shield=ShieldEffect~=nil,bolt=BoltEffect~=nil,arrow=ArrowEffect~=nil,blast=BlastEffect~=nil,hit=HitEffect~=nil,tell=TellEffect~=nil}}
end
function Clear()
 for _,v in ipairs(flying)do v.h:Release()end;flying={}
 SetArena(V.zero,1,false);queued={};later={}
end
function OnDisable()Clear()end
function OnDestroy()
 for _,v in pairs(originalSources)do v.source:Stop();U.Object.Destroy(v.go)end;originalSources={}
 Clear();if audioRoot then U.Object.Destroy(audioRoot)end
 audioClips={};audioPool={}
end

do local previous=OnDestroy;function OnDestroy()previous();ReleaseMobileDependencies()end end

local function visualSignature(go)

    end

   end

local function clamp(value, minimum, maximum)
  if value < minimum then return minimum end
  if value > maximum then return maximum end

local function subtract(a, b)
  return Vector3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z)
end

local function negate(a)
  return Vector3(-a.x, -a.y, -a.z)
end

local function dot(a, b)
  return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z
end

local function scaleVector(a, factor)
  return Vector3(a.x * factor, a.y * factor, a.z * factor)
end

local function cross(a, b)
  return Vector3(
    a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
    a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
    a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x
  )
end

local function safeUnit(value, fallback)
  local length = math.sqrt(value.x * value.x + value.y * value.y + value.z * value.z)
  if length < 0.00001 then return fallback end
  return Vector3(value.x / length, value.y / length, value.z / length)
end

local function subtractUnit(value, axis)
  local projected = scaleVector(axis, dot(value, axis))
  return subtract(value, projected)
end

local function lerpVector(a, b, t)
  return Vector3(
    a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t,
    a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t,
    a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t
  )
end

local function findMainRenderer(gameObject)
  if not isAlive(gameObject) then return nil end
  local ok, renderers = pcall(function()
    return gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(SkinnedMeshRenderer), true)
  end)
  if not ok or renderers == nil then return nil end

  local best = nil
  local bestBones = -1
  for index = 0, renderers.Length - 1 do
    local renderer = renderers[index]
    if renderer ~= nil and renderer.enabled and renderer.gameObject.activeInHierarchy and renderer.sharedMesh~=nil then
      local boneCount = 0
      local bones = renderer.bones
      if bones ~= nil then boneCount = bones.Length end
      if boneCount > bestBones then
        bestBones = boneCount
        best = renderer
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end

local function lengthOf(value)
  return math.sqrt(value.x * value.x + value.y * value.y + value.z * value.z)
end

-- 绕过 Quaternion * Vector3，直接按四元数分量旋转方向。
local function rotateVector(rotation, value)
  local qx, qy, qz, qw = rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, rotation.w
  local tx = 2 * (qy * value.z - qz * value.y)
  local ty = 2 * (qz * value.x - qx * value.z)
  local tz = 2 * (qx * value.y - qy * value.x)
  return Vector3(
    value.x + qw * tx + (qy * tz - qz * ty),
    value.y + qw * ty + (qz * tx - qx * tz),
    value.z + qw * tz + (qx * ty - qy * tx)
  )
end

local function computeBaseScale(hips, head)
  local reference = ReferenceHipsToHead
  if type(reference) ~= "number" or reference < 0.05 then reference = 0.34 end
  if hips == nil or head == nil then return nil end
  local hipsToHead = Vector3.Distance(hips, head)
  if hipsToHead <= 0.02 then return nil end
  return hipsToHead / reference
end

local function globalScaleValue()
  local value = GlobalScale
  if type(value) ~= "number" or value <= 0 then return 1 end
  return value
end

  for _,v in ipairs(PART_SPECS[entry.className]or{})do specList[#specList+1]=v end
  for _,v in ipairs(entry.extraSpecs or{})do specList[#specList+1]=v end
  if specList == nil or entry.clone == nil then return end
  for _, spec in ipairs(specList) do
    local transform = entry.clone.transform:Find(spec.name)
    if transform == nil then
      logger:warnOnce("missing-part-" .. spec.name, "outfit part not found", spec.name)
    else
      table.insert(entry.parts, {
        transform = transform,
        spec = spec,
        pitch = 0,
        roll = 0,
      })
    end
  end
end

local function disableCollidersOn(gameObject)
  if not isAlive(gameObject) then return end
  local ok, colliders = pcall(function()
    return gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(Collider), true)
  end)
  if not ok or colliders == nil then return end
  for index = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
    local collider = colliders[index]
    if collider ~= nil then collider.enabled = false end
  end
end

local function disableCollisions(clone)
  disableCollidersOn(clone)
end

local function spawnClone(entry, className)
  local sourcePath = CLASS_SOURCE[className]
  if sourcePath == nil or resourceRootTransform == nil then return false end

  local source=runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(sourcePath)
  local signature=completeVisual(source,className)
  if not signature then return false end

  local clone=entry.pendingClone
  if clone and (not isAlive(clone) or entry.pendingClass~=className or entry.pendingSignature~=signature)then
    pcall(function()Spawn.destroy(clone)end);clone=nil;entry.pendingClone=nil
  end
  if not clone then
    local ok,created=pcall(function()return Spawn.spawn(self,sourcePath,{networked=false})end)
    if not ok or not created then
      logger:warnOnce("spawn-failed-"..className,"outfit spawn failed",tostring(created));return false
    end
    clone=created;clone:SetActive(false)
    entry.pendingClone=clone;entry.pendingClass=className;entry.pendingSignature=signature
  end
  if not completeVisual(clone,className)then return false end
  entry.pendingClone=nil;entry.pendingClass=nil;entry.pendingSignature=nil
  entry.sourceSignature=signature
  clone:SetActive(false)
  clone.transform:SetParent(resourceRootTransform, true)
  clone.transform.localPosition = Vector3(0, 0, 0)
  clone.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.identity
  clone.transform.localScale = Vector3(1, 1, 1)
  disableCollisions(clone)

  entry.clone = clone
  entry.className = className
  entry.baseScale = computeBaseScale(
    bonePosition(entry.actor, HumanBodyBones.Hips),
    bonePosition(entry.actor, HumanBodyBones.Head)
  )
  entry.actorScale = actorScaleOf(entry.actor)
  tailor(entry)
  collectParts(entry)
  return true
end

local function ensureClone(entry, className)
  if entry.clone ~= nil and entry.className == className then
    if Time.time<(entry.nextHealthCheck or 0) then return end
    entry.nextHealthCheck=Time.time+.5
    local source=runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(CLASS_SOURCE[className])
    local signature=completeVisual(source,className)
    if completeVisual(entry.clone,className) and (not signature or signature==entry.sourceSignature) then return end
  end
  if entry.clone ~= nil then clearClone(entry) end
  spawnClone(entry, className)
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 骨架对齐
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 克隆创建时缓存基准缩放；之后只叠乘 GlobalScale，仅在 actor.scale 明显变化时重算。
local function worldScaleFor(entry, hips, head)
  local currentActorScale = actorScaleOf(entry.actor)
  if currentActorScale ~= nil then
    if entry.actorScale == nil then
      entry.actorScale = currentActorScale
    elseif math.abs(currentActorScale - entry.actorScale) > 0.05 then
      entry.actorScale = currentActorScale
      entry.baseScale = computeBaseScale(hips, head) or entry.baseScale
    end
  end
  -- Recompute when avatar proportions settle; actor.scale alone does not change
  -- when a placeholder is replaced by the user's final appearance.
  entry.baseScale=computeBaseScale(hips,head) or entry.baseScale
  return clamp((entry.baseScale or 1) * globalScaleValue(), MIN_SCALE, MAX_SCALE)
end

local function applyRootScale(entry, worldScale)
  if entry.clone == nil or resourceRootTransform == nil then return end
  local parentScale = resourceRootTransform.lossyScale
  local function factor(value)
    if math.abs(value) < 0.0001 then return 1 end
    return value
  end
  entry.clone.transform.localScale = Vector3(
    worldScale / factor(parentScale.x),
    worldScale / factor(parentScale.y),
    worldScale / factor(parentScale.z)
  )
end

local function limbRotation(rootPosition, endPosition, outward, fallbackUp)
  local zAxis = safeUnit(subtract(endPosition, rootPosition), fallbackUp)
  local yAxis = safeUnit(subtractUnit(outward, zAxis), fallbackUp)
  return Quaternion.LookRotation(zAxis, yAxis)
end

local function updateEntry(entry, deltaTime)
  if entry.clone == nil or entry.className == "" then return end

  if entry.visible==false or not isActorRenderable(entry) then
    if entry.clone.activeSelf then entry.clone:SetActive(false) end
    return
  end
  local actor = entry.actor
  local hips = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.Hips)
  local chest = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.Chest)
  local head = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.Head)
  local leftUpper = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.LeftUpperArm)
  local rightUpper = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.RightUpperArm)
  local leftLower = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.LeftLowerArm)
  local rightLower = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.RightLowerArm)
  local leftHand = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.LeftHand)
  local rightHand = bonePosition(actor, HumanBodyBones.RightHand)

  if hips==nil or chest==nil or head==nil or leftUpper==nil or rightUpper==nil or leftLower==nil or rightLower==nil or leftHand==nil or rightHand==nil then
    entry.clone:SetActive(false);entry.posed=false;return
  end
  local distance=Vector3.Distance(hips,head)
  if distance~=distance or distance<.02 or distance>4 then
    entry.clone:SetActive(false);entry.posed=false;return
  end

  local torsoUp = safeUnit(subtract(chest, hips), Vector3(0, 1, 0))

  -- 朝向优先取 actor.rotation 的前向，并投影到躯干 up 轴；臂展只作兜底。
  local forward = nil
  local actorRotation = actorRotationOf(actor)
  if actorRotation ~= nil then
    local ok, rawForward = pcall(function()
      return rotateVector(actorRotation, Vector3(0, 0, 1))
    end)
    if ok and rawForward ~= nil then
      local projected = subtract(rawForward, scaleVector(torsoUp, dot(rawForward, torsoUp)))
      if lengthOf(projected) > 0.0001 then
        forward = safeUnit(projected, Vector3(0, 0, 1))
      end
    end
  end
  if forward == nil and leftUpper ~= nil and rightUpper ~= nil then
    local span = subtract(rightUpper, leftUpper)
    if lengthOf(span) > 0.0001 then
      forward = safeUnit(cross(safeUnit(span, Vector3(1, 0, 0)), torsoUp), Vector3(0, 0, 1))
    end
  end
  if forward == nil then
    forward = safeUnit(cross(Vector3(1, 0, 0), torsoUp), Vector3(0, 0, 1))
  end
  local lateral = safeUnit(cross(torsoUp, forward), Vector3(1, 0, 0))
  local torsoRotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(forward, torsoUp)

  local worldScale = worldScaleFor(entry, hips, head)
  applyRootScale(entry, worldScale)

  local velocity = actor.velocity
  local velocityRight = 0
  local velocityForward = 0
  if velocity ~= nil then
    velocityRight = dot(velocity, lateral)
    velocityForward = dot(velocity, forward)
  end

  for _, part in ipairs(entry.parts) do
    local spec = part.spec
    local transform = part.transform
    if spec.kind == "torso" then
      if spec.name == "Chest" then
        transform.position = chest
      else
        transform.position = hips
      end
      transform.rotation = torsoRotation
    elseif spec.kind == "upperArm" then
      -- 源模型 +X 部件（L）跟随角色右侧骨骼，-X 部件（R）跟随左侧。
      local rootBone = spec.side == "L" and rightUpper or leftUpper
      local endBone = spec.side == "L" and rightLower or leftLower
      if endBone ~= nil and rootBone ~= nil then
        local outward = spec.side == "L" and lateral or negate(lateral)
        local anchor = rootBone
        if spec.shift ~= nil then
          anchor = lerpVector(rootBone, endBone, spec.shift)
        end
        transform.position = anchor
        transform.rotation = limbRotation(rootBone, endBone, outward, torsoUp)
      end
    elseif spec.kind == "forearm" then
      local elbow = spec.side == "L" and rightLower or leftLower
      local hand = spec.side == "L" and rightHand or leftHand
      if elbow ~= nil then
        local outward = spec.side == "L" and lateral or negate(lateral)
        local endPosition = hand
        if endPosition == nil then
          local rootBone = spec.side == "L" and rightUpper or leftUpper
          endPosition = Vector3(
            elbow.x + (elbow.x - rootBone.x),
            elbow.y + (elbow.y - rootBone.y),
            elbow.z + (elbow.z - rootBone.z)
          )
        end
        transform.position = lerpVector(elbow, endPosition, 0.45)
        transform.rotation = limbRotation(elbow, endPosition, outward, torsoUp)
      end
    elseif spec.kind == "hem" or spec.kind == "torsoOffset" then
      local reference = hips
      if spec.parent == "chest" then reference = chest elseif spec.parent == "head"then reference=head end
      local offset = spec.offset
      local offsetX = offset[1] * worldScale
      local offsetY = offset[2] * worldScale
      local offsetZ = offset[3] * worldScale
      transform.position = Vector3(
        reference.x + lateral.x * offsetX + torsoUp.x * offsetY + forward.x * offsetZ,
        reference.y + lateral.y * offsetX + torsoUp.y * offsetY + forward.y * offsetZ,
        reference.z + lateral.z * offsetX + torsoUp.z * offsetY + forward.z * offsetZ
      )

      if spec.kind == "hem" then
        local targetPitch = spec.basePitch + clamp(velocityForward * 9, -spec.forwardLimit, spec.backLimit)
        local targetRoll = clamp(-velocityRight * 7, -spec.rollLimit, spec.rollLimit)
        local idle = math.sin(elapsed * 1.6 + spec.phase) * 0.9
        local smoothing = 1 - math.exp(-deltaTime * 7)
        part.pitch = part.pitch + (targetPitch + idle - part.pitch) * smoothing
        part.roll = part.roll + (targetRoll - part.roll) * smoothing
        transform.rotation = torsoRotation * Quaternion.Euler(part.pitch, 0, part.roll)
      else
        transform.rotation = torsoRotation
      end
    end
  end
  entry.posed=true
  if not entry.clone.activeSelf then entry.clone:SetActive(true)end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Actor 同步
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function syncActor(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  local gameObject = actorGameObject(actor)
  if not isAlive(gameObject) then return end
  local actorId = actorIdOf(actor)
  if actorId == nil then return end
  local entry = actors[actorId]
  if entry == nil then
    entry = {
      actor = actor,
      actorID = actorId,
      className = "",
      clone = nil,
      parts = {},
      mainRenderer = nil,
      visible = true,
    }
    actors[actorId] = entry
  end

  entry.actor = actor
  local className, visible = readState(actor)
  entry.visible = visible
  if entry.mainRenderer == nil then
    entry.mainRenderer = findMainRenderer(gameObject)
  end

  if className == "" then
    clearClone(entry)
    return
  end

  ensureClone(entry, className)
  if not visible or not isActorRenderable(entry) then
    if entry.clone ~= nil and entry.clone.activeSelf then
      entry.clone:SetActive(false)
    end
    return
  end

  -- LateUpdate enables the clone only after a complete valid bone pose.
end

local function refreshActors()
  local ok, list = pcall(function()
    return CS.DouyinActorService.GetActors()
  end)
  if not ok or list == nil then return end

  local seen = {}
  for index = 0, list.Length - 1 do
    local actor = list[index]
    local gameObject = actorGameObject(actor)
    local actorId = actorIdOf(actor)
    if actor ~= nil and isAlive(gameObject) and actorId ~= nil then
      seen[actorId] = true
      syncActor(actor)
    end
  end

  local stale = {}
  for actorId, entry in pairs(actors) do
    if seen[actorId] ~= true then
      table.insert(stale, actorId)
    end
    if entry.actor == nil or not isAlive(actorGameObject(entry.actor)) then
      table.insert(stale, actorId)
    end
  end
  for _, actorId in ipairs(stale) do
    local entry = actors[actorId]
    if entry ~= nil then
      clearClone(entry)
      actors[actorId] = nil
    end
  end
end

local function clearAll()
  for actorId, entry in pairs(actors) do
    clearClone(entry)
  end
  actors = {}
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Runtime Host 接入
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function handleRefresh(eventName, payload)
  if eventName ~= REFRESH_EVENT then return false end
  if type(payload) ~= "table" then return false end

  local actorId = tonumber(payload.actorID)
  if actorId == nil then
    refreshTimer = REFRESH_INTERVAL
    return true
  end

  local ok, actor = pcall(function()
    return CS.DouyinActorService.GetActorById(actorId)
  end)
  if not ok or actor == nil then return true end

  syncActor(actor)
  return true
end

local function registerWithHost()
  if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil or resourceEntry ~= nil then return end
  local host = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host == nil or type(host.RegisterResource) ~= "function" then
    logger:warnOnce("runtime-host-unavailable", "outfit refresh events disabled")
    return
  end
  resourceEntry = host.RegisterResource(resourceRoot, RESOURCE_ID, {
    events = { REFRESH_EVENT },
    handler = handleRefresh,
    options = { resourceId = RESOURCE_ID },
  })
end

local function unregisterFromHost()
  if resourceEntry == nil or runtimeScope == nil then return end
  local host = runtimeScope:GetRuntimeHostScript("runtime-host.lua")
  if host ~= nil and type(host.UnregisterResource) == "function" then
    host.UnregisterResource(resourceEntry)
  end
  resourceEntry = nil
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 生命周期
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local nextInitAttempt=-1
local outfitStatus="waiting resources"
function Start()
 if started or Time.time<nextInitAttempt then return end
 nextInitAttempt=Time.time+.5
 -- RuntimeScope is fixed by the saved binding; retry only model payload readiness.
 resourceRoot=runtimeScope and runtimeScope:GetResourceRoot()or nil
 resourceRootTransform=resourceRoot and resourceRoot.transform or nil
 if not resourceRoot then outfitStatus="scope unavailable";return end
 local sourceSets=runtimeScope:GetTransformByPath(SOURCE_SETS_PATH)
 if not sourceSets then outfitStatus="source sets missing";return end
 for className,path in pairs(CLASS_SOURCE)do
  if not runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(path)then outfitStatus="source missing: "..className;return end
 end
 disableCollidersOn(resourceRoot)
 sourceSets.localPosition=PROTOTYPE_PARK
 disableCollidersOn(sourceSets.gameObject)
 started=true;outfitStatus="resources ready"
 registerWithHost()
 refreshActors()
end

function OnEnable()
  if started then registerWithHost() end
end

function OnDisable()
  unregisterFromHost()
  clearAll()
end

function OnDestroy()
  unregisterFromHost()
  clearAll()
end

function OnActorSpawned(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  syncActor(actor)
end

function OnActorDespawned(actor)
  if actor == nil then return end
  local actorId = actorIdOf(actor)
  if actorId == nil then return end
  local entry = actors[actorId]
  if entry ~= nil then
    clearClone(entry)
    actors[actorId] = nil
  end
end

function Update()
  if not started then Start()end
  if not started then return end
  if not resourceEntry then registerWithHost()end
  refreshTimer = refreshTimer + Time.deltaTime
  if refreshTimer >= REFRESH_INTERVAL then
    refreshTimer = 0
    refreshActors()
  end
end

function LateUpdate()
  if runtimeScope == nil or resourceRoot == nil then return end
  local deltaTime = Time.deltaTime
  elapsed = elapsed + deltaTime

  for _, entry in pairs(actors) do
    updateEntry(entry, deltaTime)
  end
end
-- Driven by the existing replicated combat snapshot; no second network state.
function Equip(actor, className)
 if not started then Start()end
 if not started then return false end
 local id=actorIdOf(actor)
 if id==nil or CLASS_SOURCE[className]==nil then return false end
 local state=gameStates[id]
 if not state or state.actor~=actor or state.className~=className then
  gameStates[id]={actor=actor,className=className,visible=state==nil or state.visible}
  syncActor(actor)
 end
 local entry=actors[id]
 return entry~=nil and isAlive(entry.clone) and entry.sourceSignature~=nil
end
function SetVisible(actor, visible)
 local id=actorIdOf(actor);local state=id and gameStates[id]
 if not state then return false end
 if state.visible~=(visible==true)then state.visible=visible==true;syncActor(actor)end
 return true
end
function Unequip(actor)
 local id=actorIdOf(actor);if id==nil then return end
 gameStates[id]=nil
 local entry=actors[id]
 if entry then clearClone(entry);actors[id]=nil end
end

function GetOutfitStatus(actor)
 local entry=actors[actorIdOf(actor)]
 if not entry or not entry.clone then return outfitStatus.."; clone pending"end
 return entry.clone.activeInHierarchy and "visible"or "hidden"
end

function ResourcesReady()
 if not started then Start()end
 if not started then return false,outfitStatus end
 for className,path in pairs(CLASS_SOURCE)do
  if not completeVisual(runtimeScope:GetGameObjectByPath(path),className)then return false,"outfit mesh pending: "..className end
 end
 return true,"ready"
end
function IsReady(actor,className)
 local id=actorIdOf(actor);local entry=id and actors[id]
 if not entry or entry.className~=className or not isAlive(entry.clone)then return false end
 return entry.posed==true and entry.clone.activeInHierarchy and completeVisual(entry.clone,className)~=nil
end

do local previous=OnDestroy;function OnDestroy()if previous then previous()end;ReleaseMobileDependencies()end end

local scope=require('official.core.runtime_scope').from(self)

do
 local target=scope
 local original=target.GetScript
 local memo,attempts,nextAt={},{},{}
 local failures={}
 target.GetScript=function(_,name)
  if memo[name] then return memo[name] end
  local now=CS.UnityEngine.Time.realtimeSinceStartup
  if (attempts[name] or 0)>=30 or now<(nextAt[name] or 0) then return nil end
  attempts[name]=(attempts[name] or 0)+1;nextAt[name]=now+1

  if ok and value then memo[name]=value;return value end
  if attempts[name]==30 then failures[name]=tostring(value or 'not loaded');print('[mobile-v21] dependency failed: '..name..' '..failures[name]) end

 end

end

local rules,profile
local sequence=0
-- Session-only progression: materials and daily quotas follow normal rules.
local stopped=false
local message=''
local function ready()
 if stopped then return false end
 if not rules then rules=scope:GetScript('dragon_progress_rules.lua')end
 if not rules then return false end
 if not profile then profile=rules.New()end
 return true
end
function IsLoaded()return ready()end
function GetProfile()if ready()then return rules.Copy(profile)end end

function GetStatus()return{loaded=ready(),busy=false,pending=false,message=message,revision=profile and profile.revision,preview=PreviewOnly,persistent=false,testMode=false}end
function Submit(kind,args,callback)
 if not ready()then return false,'玩法正在初始化'end
 local t=CS.DouyinUtility.GetServerUnixTime()+CS.DouyinUtility.GetServerTime().Millisecond/1000
 sequence=sequence+1
 local op=rules.Copy(args or{});op.kind=kind;op.id='session:'..sequence;op.now=t;op.day=math.floor((t+28800)/86400)
 local updated,reason,repeated=rules.Apply(profile,op)
 if not updated then return false,reason end
 profile=updated;message=reason or ''
 if callback then callback(true,message,repeated)end
 return true,op.id
end
function SelectClass(kind,callback)return Submit('class',{class=kind},callback)end
function AwardBattle(battleId,amount,callback)return Submit('battle',{battleId=battleId,amount=amount},callback)end
function Retry()return ready()end
function Update()ready()end
function OnDestroy()stopped=true;profile=nil end

do local previous=OnDestroy;function OnDestroy()if previous then previous()end;ReleaseMobileDependencies()end end

function SetMode(mode)
 if not context or not actor then return false end
 if mode~="combat"and mode~="explore"then return false end
 if mode==context.mode then return true end
 if mode=="combat"then
  if not profile.class then OpenContract(false,nil);return false end
  if not ready or context.menu or external.menu or external.mounted or actor:IsSitting()or actor:IsFlying()or external.dead then return false end
  if not weapons.Equip(actor,profile.class)then toast("武器正在准备，请稍候");return false end
  -- Only take the native global slots when they are free.
  for _,kind in ipairs({CS.UIType.CustomMain,CS.UIType.CustomSub})do
   local b=CS.DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(kind)
   if not b or b.gameObject.activeSelf then weapons.Unequip(actor);toast("请先结束当前操作");return false end
  end
  bindSlot(CS.UIType.CustomMain,"",function()held=true;attackPressed=true end,function()held=false end,CS.UIType.Jump)
  bindSlot(CS.UIType.CustomSub,"",function()skillPressed=1;skillPressedAt=U.Time.time end,function()end,CS.UIType.HoldHands)
  local cls=rules.GetClasses()[profile.class]
  native[1].button.image.sprite=K.sprite('cb_atk')
   setIcon(native[1].button,profile.class=="melee"and "sword"or(profile.class=="mage"and "staff"or "bow"),112)
  setIcon(native[2].button,cls.skills[1].icon,78)
  for i=2,3 do local v=skillButtons[i];setIcon(v.button,cls.skills[i].icon,78);v.button.gameObject:SetActive(true)end
  hideExplore();context.mode="combat";toggleLabel.text="";setIcon(toggle,"exit",C15.iconSize or 60)
 else
  clearSlots();context.mode="explore";weapons.Unequip(actor);fx.Clear();toggleLabel.text="";setIcon(toggle,"duel",C15.iconSize or 70)
 end
 return true
end
function IsContractOpen()return contract~=nil and contract.activeInHierarchy end
function OpenContract(change,callback,parent)
 if not rules or not actor or not buildUI()then return false end

 local bridge=scope:GetScript('dragon_world_bridge.lua')

 contract:GetComponent(typeof(U.UI.RawImage)).enabled=parent==nil

 if external.inBattle or external.mounted or actor:IsSitting()or actor:IsFlying()then toast("请先结束战斗或骑乘");return false end
 SetMode("explore");context.menu=true;ready=false;respec=change;selection=nil;contractCallback=callback
 C15.select(nil);C15.group.alpha=0;contract:SetActive(true);backdrop:SetActive(parent==nil);contract.transform:SetAsLastSibling();if previewButton then previewButton.gameObject:SetActive(false)end;actor:Immobilize(true)
 return true
end
function SetContext(value)
 if value and value.mounted and not external.mounted and context and context.mode=='combat'then resumeAfterMount=true end
 for k,v in pairs(value or {})do external[k]=v end
 if external.menu or external.mounted or external.dead then SetMode("explore")end
end
function SetExplorationReady(value)ready=value==true end
function SetProfile(value)
 if not value or value.schema~=2 then return false end
 profile=value;if context then context.class=value.class end;return true
end
function GetProfile()return profile end
function GetStatus()
 return {mode=context and context.mode,class=profile and profile.class,ready=ready,sequence=context and context.sequence,contract=contract and contract.activeSelf,
  nativeSlots=#native,skills=rules and profile and profile.class and rules.GetClasses()[profile.class].skills,skillCooldowns=context and {context.skill1Until,context.skill2Until,context.skill3Until},pending=#pending,held=held,outfit=actor and outfits and outfits.GetOutfitStatus(actor),
  weapon=actor and weapons and weapons.GetRigStatus(actor),battle=battle and battle.GetStatus()}
end
local function act(kind)
 local action=rules.TryAction(context,kind,U.Time.time);if not action then return false end
 local d=actor.rotation*V3.forward;local p=actor.position;local target=V3(p.x+d.x*action.range,p.y+.65,p.z+d.z*action.range);local aim=battle and battle.GetAim(d,action.range);if aim then target=aim;local delta=target-V3(p.x,p.y+.65,p.z);delta.y=0;if delta.sqrMagnitude>.001 then d=delta.normalized end end
 if weapons.Attack(actor,profile.class,kind,target)then
  action.origin=V3(p.x,p.y+.65,p.z);action.direction=d;if not(battle and battle.SendAction(action))then fx.Charge(action.class,action.kind,action.origin,target);pending[#pending+1]=action end
  return true
 end
 return false
end
function OnUIPointerDown(ui)
 if not context or context.mode~='combat'then return end
 if ui==CS.UIType.CustomMain then held=true;attackPressed=true
 elseif ui==CS.UIType.CustomSub then skillPressed=1;skillPressedAt=U.Time.time end
end
function OnUIPointerUp(ui)if ui==CS.UIType.CustomMain then held=false end end
function FixedUpdate()
 if not context or not actor or context.mode~="combat"then return end
 context.mounted=external.mounted or actor:IsSitting();context.flying=actor:IsFlying();context.dead=external.dead;context.menu=external.menu or(contract and contract.activeSelf)
 if not rules.CanUse(context)then SetMode("explore");return end
 if skillPressed then if U.Time.time-skillPressedAt>.65 or act("skill"..skillPressed)then skillPressed=false end elseif held or attackPressed then attackPressed=false;act("attack")end
end
function Update()
 if not scope then return end
 if not rules then rules=scope:GetScript("dragon_rules.lua");outfits=scope:GetScript("dragon_outfits.lua");weapons=scope:GetScript("dragon_weapons.lua");fx=scope:GetScript("dragon_fx.lua")end
 if not rules or not outfits or not weapons or not fx then rules=nil;return end
 if not battle then battle=scope:GetScript("dragon_combat.lua")end
 if not combatRules then combatRules=scope:GetScript("dragon_combat_rules.lua")end
 actor=CS.DouyinActorService.GetLocalActor();if not actor then return end
 if not progress then progress=scope:GetScript("dragon_progress.lua")end
 if not progress or not progress.IsLoaded()then return end
 profile=progress.GetProfile()
 if not context then context={mode="explore",class=profile.class}end
 context.class=profile.class
 if battle and combatRules then battle.Configure({GetProfile=GetProfile,SetMode=SetMode,SetContext=SetContext,ShowDamage=ShowDamage,AwardBattle=progress.AwardBattle},rules,fx,combatRules)end
 if not buildUI()then return end
 root:SetActive(true)
 context.menu=external.menu or(contract and contract.activeSelf)or false
 context.mounted=external.mounted or actor:IsSitting()
 context.flying=actor:IsFlying();context.dead=external.dead
 updateFeedback()
 if PreviewMode and not openedPreview then openedPreview=OpenContract(false,nil)end
 if profile.class then outfits.Equip(actor,profile.class)end
 local available=ready and not context.menu and not external.menu and not external.mounted and not external.dead and not actor:IsSitting()and not actor:IsFlying()
 toggle.gameObject:SetActive(available)
 if resumeAfterMount and available and U.Time.time>=resumeRetry then
  resumeRetry=U.Time.time+.75;if SetMode('combat')then resumeAfterMount=false end
 end
 if battleButton then battleButton.gameObject:SetActive(false);battleHUD.gameObject:SetActive(false)end
 if contract.activeSelf and C15.group then
  C15.group.alpha=math.min(1,C15.group.alpha+U.Time.unscaledDeltaTime*3.5)
  if selection and uiRefs[selection]then local sc=1.1+.012*math.sin(U.Time.unscaledTime*4);uiRefs[selection].rt.localScale=V3(sc,sc,1)end
 end
 local nearArena=battle and battle.IsNearArena()
 local nearDuel=battle and battle.IsNearDuel()
 local showTrial=available and battle and (nearArena or nearDuel or battle.IsParticipating())
 if showTrial and not nativeTrial then
  nativeTrial=self:AddInteractorButton()
  if nativeTrial then nativeTrial.onClick:AddListener(function()if battle.IsParticipating()then battle.Retreat()else local ok,why=battle.Begin(battle.IsNearDuel());if not ok then toast(why)end end end)end
 elseif not showTrial and nativeTrial then self:RemoveInteractorButton(nativeTrial);nativeTrial=nil end
 if nativeTrial then local t=nativeTrial:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(U.UI.Text),true);if t then t.text=battle.IsParticipating()and(battle.IsDuel()and "认输离场"or "离开试炼")or(nearDuel and(battle.IsDuelOpen()and "加入对决"or "发起对决")or "挑战影灵")end end
 local safe=U.Screen.safeArea;local scale=1080/U.Screen.height
 local rt=toggle.transform
 -- 拔剑键跟原生的跳跃键、牵手键排成一道弧：和牵手键一样大，落在弧线上牵手键的下一个位置
 local hand=CS.DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(CS.HandType.Right,CS.UIType.HoldHands)
 local jump=CS.DouyinUIService.GetInteractionButton(CS.HandType.Right,CS.UIType.Jump)
 if hand and jump and context.mode~="combat"then
  local h,j=hand.transform,jump.transform
  local unit=root.transform.lossyScale.x
  local size=h.rect.width*h.lossyScale.x/unit
  if size>20 then
   rt.sizeDelta=V2(size,size)
   if C15.iconSize~=size*.56 then C15.iconSize=size*.56;setIcon(toggle,"duel",C15.iconSize)end
   local d=h.position-j.position
   local q=U.Quaternion.Euler(0,0,-62)*V3(d.x,d.y,0)
   C15.togglePos=j.position+q
  end
 end
 if context.mode=="combat"then rt.anchoredPosition=V2(-(U.Screen.width-safe.xMax)*scale-74,(safe.yMin)*scale+392)
 elseif C15.togglePos then rt.position=C15.togglePos
 else rt.anchoredPosition=V2(-(U.Screen.width-safe.xMax)*scale-108,(safe.yMin)*scale+350)end
 if not available and context.mode=="combat"then SetMode("explore")end
 if context.mode=="combat"then
  for i=1,2 do
   if not combatAnchors[i]then local go,rt=rect(root.transform,"CombatAnchor"..i,i==1 and 216 or 136,i==1 and 216 or 136,i==1 and -215 or -235,i==1 and 185 or 422,V2(1,0));combatAnchors[i]=rt end
   local slot=native[i];if slot then slot.button.transform.position=combatAnchors[i].position;slot.button.transform.sizeDelta=combatAnchors[i].sizeDelta*(combatAnchors[i].lossyScale.x/slot.button.transform.parent.lossyScale.x) end
  end

    local glyph=slot.button.transform:Find("ActionGlyph");if glyph then glyph:GetComponent(typeof(U.UI.Image)).color=left>0 and U.Color(1,1,1,.22)or U.Color.white end
    slot.button.image.color=left>0 and U.Color(.8,.8,.8,1)or U.Color.white

     local cim=g:AddComponent(typeof(U.UI.Image));cim.sprite=K.sprite('cb_cd');cim.type=U.UI.Image.Type.Filled;cim.fillMethod=U.UI.Image.FillMethod.Radial360;cim.raycastTarget=false;slot.cdo=cim

 end
